WITH linked_signals AS (
  SELECT 
    s.signalregistry,
    s.modindex,
    s.phaseshiftdeg,
    t.telescregistry,
    o.weathprofile
  FROM signals s
  INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) as baseline_modindex
  FROM linked_signals
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ls.weathprofile,
    ls.telescregistry,
    AVG(ls.modindex) as group_avg_modindex,
    AVG(ls.phaseshiftdeg) as group_avg_phaseshift
  FROM linked_signals ls
  GROUP BY ls.telescregistry, ls.weathprofile
),
kept_groups AS (
  SELECT
    gs.weathprofile,
    gs.group_avg_modindex,
    gs.group_avg_phaseshift,
    (gs.group_avg_modindex - b.baseline_modindex) as modindex_above_baseline
  FROM group_stats gs
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE gs.group_avg_modindex > b.baseline_modindex
)
SELECT
  weathprofile,
  AVG(group_avg_modindex) as avg_kept_modindex,
  AVG(group_avg_phaseshift) as avg_kept_phaseshift,
  AVG(modindex_above_baseline) as avg_above_baseline
FROM kept_groups
GROUP BY weathprofile

assumptions.assumption: Each telescope is associated with exactly one observatory and weather profile; the (telescope, weather_profile) grouping is determined entirely by the telescope's location.
The baseline average modulation index is computed from all successfully linked signals before any group filtering occurs.
NULL values in modindex or phaseshiftdeg are excluded from averages per standard SQL AVG semantics.
